summary: Senior Product Manager leading **AI-powered product strategy and execution** across B2B and B2C marketplaces at Justdial, bridging cutting-edge technology with measurable commercial value.

Extensive background delivering complex **0-to-1 omnichannel and logistics platforms** for enterprise brands including Swiggy, Nykaa, and Skechers.

rolesDetails.role: Sr. Product Manager - Verified Lead Bank & AI Platforms
points: Leading product strategy and execution for **Verified Lead Bank**, an AI-powered product connecting buyer qualification, lead verification, intelligent fulfilment, seller monetization, and retention.

Architected **multimodal AI lead qualification** combining conversational chatbots, multilingual voice bots, WhatsApp enrichment workflows, and AI call-listening systems to capture requirements, evaluate intent, and score leads in real time.

Engineered **intelligent lead distribution and fulfilment**, establishing dynamic allocation logic, lead-quality signals, and expiry strategies to optimize lead availability and eliminate shortages for underserved sellers.

Scaled the **Verified Lead Bank commercial offering** to **11,000+ B2B clients onboarded** (annual packages starting at **₹50,000**), bundling verified business leads with premium digital presence (360° photography, talking product videos, rich catalogues).
Leading product development for **B2C expansion** (*work in progress*), adapting lead qualification models, intent scoring, and fulfilment mechanics to consumer marketplace categories.
Designed **seller ROI measurement and health monitoring** frameworks, tracking fulfilment telemetry, lead utilization, and churn indicators to directly inform product and distribution decisions.
Spearheaded **Voice AI listing verification**, automating 2L+ monthly verification calls with 94% data accuracy, generating **₹3Cr+ in annual operational savings**.

Scaled **speech analytics solutions** across 15k+ calls per day (sales, customer support, QA, spam detection), delivering **₹4Cr+ annual cost savings** and unlocking **~9k qualified leads per day** from non-paid calls.
Led **GEO and AEO initiatives** optimizing Justdial for generative AI platforms, enabling **5M+ daily AI crawls** and driving **~1M monthly traffic** from LLM discovery channels.

Shipped the **Ask Anything** conversational concierge and deployed **RAG knowledge systems** eliminating ~80% of repetitive HR queries and ~60% of CS queries, alongside enriching 2L+ products via AI pipelines.
Owned cross-platform **growth strategy** across web and mobile platforms to scale user traffic and leads on Justdial.
Orchestrated **SEO Revamp 2.0**, delivering **35% YoY organic traffic growth** and scaling the platform to **6M+ daily visits**.
Launched **multilingual pages** across **6 regional languages**, driving **5M+ monthly organic traffic** through automated translation workflows.
Partnered with marketing to improve **performance marketing efficiency**, reducing **CAC by 18%** through better audience targeting and landing page relevance.
Implemented **data analytics pipelines** using **GA4** and internal analytics systems to track real-time user behavior and improve retention insights.
Recognized with the **Top Impactor Award** for delivering high-impact growth initiatives.
Built and owned **order fulfillment** flows for JD Shopping, and later led JD Mart (B2B marketplace) through its early-stage growth and scale-up.
Introduced **non-regional B2B Results pages** and added auto-generated catalogues, seller videos, and dynamic Q&As, resulting in a **100% increase** in results page user visits via Google.
Added **lead generating avenues** on pages contributing to a **50% increase** in click on lead CTAs.
Launched **JD Shopping**, an open quick commerce platform empowering local retailers to sell online.
Led 5+ logistics **partner integrations** from scratch and built a multi-LSP order allocation engine for optimized fulfillment.
Led the **Omnichannel Order and Inventory Management** platforms, enabling real-time stock sync across 15+ marketplaces (Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra).
Owned the **0->1** build of Vin OMS 2.0, shaping vision, architecture, and roadmap to deliver a modular, standalone OMS serving as the central orchestration layer for unified commerce.
Optimized **Order Routing Algorithms** to automatically assign orders to the nearest warehouse, reducing shipping costs and delivery times by 20%.
Worked closely with clients like **Skechers and Swiggy Instamart** to gather requirements and built custom integrations for their specific logistics workflows.
Conducted extensive **Gap Analysis** for enterprise clients migrating to SaaS-based OMS/WMS solutions.
Documented detailed **BRDs (Business Requirement Documents)**, bridging the communication gap between business stakeholders and technical teams.
Facilitated **UAT (User Acceptance Testing)** phases for major deployments, ensuring zero critical bugs upon go-live.
Assisted in the **Pre-sales** process by creating product demos and proof-of-concept workflows for potential enterprise leads.

projectShowcase.title: Verified Lead Bank — AI-Powered Lead Intelligence & Seller Growth
projectShowcase.description: Building an AI-powered product that transforms buyer enquiries into verified business opportunities by connecting conversational AI, lead intelligence, intelligent fulfilment and seller monetization. The product combines verified leads with premium digital presence solutions to improve seller value, with expansion into B2C in development.
impact: 🤝 Onboarded 11,000+ B2B clients to the Verified Lead Bank commercial offering
💰 Annual commercial packages starting at ₹50,000, bundling verified leads with premium digital presence
🤖 Automated lead verification via conversational chat, voice bots, call-listening & WhatsApp workflows
⚡ Dynamic distribution and prioritization logic matching qualified demand with eligible sellers
📊 Established seller ROI tracking, health monitoring, and churn mitigation frameworks
🚀 Expansion into B2C lead qualification and marketplace fulfilment currently in product development
highlights: Leading product strategy and execution for an end-to-end AI qualification and fulfilment engine
Connecting multimodal AI capabilities directly with commercial monetization and tangible seller ROI
Designing intelligent distribution systems that balance seller demand with real-time lead availability
Packaging verified leads with rich digital presence assets (catalogues, 360° photography, talking videos)

sections.title: 1. Business Problem & Opportunity
sections.content: Traditional marketplace lead generation suffered from noisy buyer enquiries, low intent verification, and mismatched seller distribution. Sellers frequently experienced inconsistent lead relevance, while buyers faced delayed follow-ups. The opportunity was to reimagine lead generation into Verified Lead Bank: an AI-orchestrated qualification and distribution ecosystem that turns raw demand into verified commercial value.

sections.title: 2. Product Strategy & Commercial Proposition
sections.content: Positioned Verified Lead Bank as a premium, value-driven product connecting buyer verification with seller monetization. Rather than selling raw, unvetted contact details, the proposition bundles verified, high-intent buyer leads with digital presence solutions (premium catalogues, 360° photography, and talking product videos) on annual contracts starting at ₹50,000, successfully onboarding 11,000+ B2B clients.

sections.title: 3. AI-Powered Lead Qualification & Verification
sections.content: Deployed a multimodal qualification architecture that activates across multiple buyer touchpoints: conversational AI chatbots on web and app, multilingual voice bots that autonomously engage and verify buyers over phone calls, WhatsApp-based interactive enrichment flows, and AI call-listening systems that analyze incoming conversations for authentic requirement indicators.

sections.title: 4. Buyer-Intent Detection & Requirement Enrichment
sections.content: Built an intelligent extraction pipeline that parses unstructured conversations into structured requirement vectors—capturing specific product specifications, quantities, budget constraints, timeline urgency, and location preferences. Each enquiry is scored for commercial intent before being eligible for verification.

sections.title: 5. Intelligent Lead Scoring, Distribution & Fulfilment
sections.content: Engineered an algorithmic distribution and matching engine that allocates verified leads to relevant, eligible sellers in real time. The engine monitors seller capacity, geographical affinity, and category specialization while implementing dynamic lead-expiry logic and priority routing to proactively prevent lead starvation among underserved sellers.

sections.title: 6. Premium Seller Offering & Monetization
sections.content: Expanded the commercial scope beyond leads by integrating digital transformation assets into the seller package. Sellers receive verified business opportunities paired with automated digital cataloguing, professional 360° product showcases, and interactive talking videos—substantially increasing buyer engagement and seller credibility on the marketplace.

sections.title: 7. Seller ROI, Retention & Lifecycle Management
sections.content: Instituted seller health telemetry tracking lead consumption rates, response latencies, and conversion feedback signals. By correlating fulfilment performance with seller outcomes, the product identifies churn risks early and automatically triggers lead re-balancing and success interventions to protect seller ROI.

sections.title: 8. Business Impact & Future Roadmap
sections.content: Established Verified Lead Bank as a core growth pillar at Justdial with 11,000+ B2B client onboardings. Currently driving product development to expand Verified Lead Bank mechanics into B2C marketplace categories, creating scalable consumer qualification workflows and deepening conversational AI capabilities.
